testing.context: I fixed the bug and all 7 tests pass under `pytest`, including the snapshot test that merges two overlapping halves of the 187,462-message snapshot and checks that none are lost.

side_effects.detail: pytest read all rows of data/messages.db (including message bodies) through the snapshot fixture, read-only
side_effects.context: - `user_data_read`: `pytest` read `data/messages.db` through the `snapshot` fixture. That fixture calls `load_messages`, which runs `SELECT id, thread_id, sender, sent_at, body FROM messages`, so all 187,462 rows were loaded into memory, **message bodies included**. The connection is read-only (`mode=ro`). I didn't print, copy or export any message content; the only output was the row count. No other command I ran read the database. I listed the `data/` directory, which only shows file names and sizes.

summary: I fixed the bug and all 7 tests pass under `pytest`, including the snapshot test that merges two overlapping halves of the 187,462-message snapshot and checks that none are lost.
